hero.headline: Flavors of Civilization
hero.subheadline: Rooted in tradition. Crafted for today.
hero.copy: Rediscover the beauty of real ingredients, timeless flavors, and food prepared with purpose.

intro.headline: A Return to Real Nourishment
intro.body: At NEFRA, we believe food should be as honest as it is flavorful. Inspired by the culinary traditions that have connected civilizations for generations, we bring real ingredients, thoughtful preparation, and exceptional hospitality together in a modern dining experience.

featured.headline: Crafted with Purpose. Served with Flavor.

philosophy.headline: Food as It Was Meant to Be
philosophy.body: Before shortcuts became the standard, food was rooted in ingredients, craftsmanship, and connection. NEFRA is our way of bringing those values forward.

pillars.title: Real Ingredients
pillars.body: Thoughtfully selected ingredients that prioritize quality and flavor.

pillars.title: Thoughtful Sourcing
pillars.body: A commitment to transparency and responsible ingredient selection.

pillars.title: Time-Honored Craft
pillars.body: Traditional culinary methods brought into the modern kitchen.

pillars.title: Genuine Hospitality
pillars.body: More than a meal. An experience built around people and community.

story.headline: A Vision Rooted in Something Greater
body: NEFRA grew out of a passion for food, health, culinary tradition and community, and a belief that a quick meal can still be made with care.
Our founder spent years developing a concept that brings thoughtful sourcing and memorable flavor together in a modern fast-casual restaurant, where everyone is welcome at the table.

community.headline: More Than Food. A Place to Connect.
community.body: The best meals are shared. NEFRA is being built as a gathering place for families, neighbors, coworkers and friends, and we're sharing the journey to opening day as we go.
